text:
maya: heads up — seeing steady mem growth on prod-dedicated during a long-chat repro. KV pages increase even though eviction runs.
jorge: different from the stale-tag leaks we saw before? thread_ts 1793001234 was the last one.
maya: not the same. this looks like an alignment drift: pages get freed but later appends land on the freed offsets. freed pages then appear allocated again.
kevin: can you paste a short snapshot (page counts, free_list, last_append_offset, alloc checksum)?
maya: canary snapshot @ 17:42:
```
shard=3 pages_total=4096 pages_free=120 pages_in_use=3976
free_list_len=118 last_append_offset=4096 next_alloc_hint=16
alloc_map_checksum=0x7f3a2b
```
maya: after a few minutes pages_free drops to 8 but pages_total stays 4096; alloc_map_checksum flips.
sam: compactor logs around that time: `compactor: start shard=3 epochs=(1234->1235) free_before=120 free_after=12`
li: that smells like a race: compactor moves pages and updates metadata while append uses a stale next_alloc_hint.
kevin: did we recently make sparse eviction lockless? I recall PR #4532 swapped the shard mutex for an atomic cursor to reduce tail latency.
maya: yep. we reverted other changes but that cursor change stayed.
jorge: repro steps?
maya: ./dev/repro/kv_alignment_drift.py --long-context=64k --concurrent-appenders=8. you can see last_append_offset wrap and an append landing in a freed page header.
li: runtime log snippet from my run shows header mismatch: 
```
[2026-01-18T17:42:12Z] append shard=3 off=4096 hdr.magic=0xC0FFEE hdr.seq=200
[2026-01-18T17:42:12Z] compactor moved page shard=3 from off=4096 -> off=8192 seq=201
[2026-01-18T17:42:12Z] append wrote at off=4096 after compaction
```
kevin: so a compaction/migration freed/relocated a page but append wrote to the old offset — cross-request contamination and stale blocks.
sam: short mitigation: add a cheap sanity check in append: read hdr.magic before overwrite; if mismatch retry. cheap and buys time.
maya: implemented a local guard: read header.magic with acquire semantics; if != expected, refresh cursor and retry. with guard, repro shows no growth for 10m.
jorge: good temporary fix. root cause likely the lockless cursor allowing append to use stale allocation hints while compactor reclaims. revert or strengthen coordination.
li: design: compactor increments shard_generation before reclamation; append validates cached generation and retries if mismatch. atomic generation token avoids full shard lock. similar to slot-rotation approach in PR #4120.
kevin: agreed. compactor should also publish moved-page indirection so concurrent readers can resolve relocated pages instead of overwriting.
runtime-bot: CI queued: eng-runtime/kv_alignment_drift_repro
deploy-bot: canary r-2026.1.4532 deployed to canary pool (3 nodes)
maya: after guard + generation bump in canary, mem stable for 30m on repro. planning 10% canary roll.
sam: add a short incident note with repro steps and logs. tag eng-sre for observability follow-up.
kevin: follow-up: schedule profiler run to measure tail-latency impact of the guard. if small, keep guard while landing generation-based fix.
maya: creating PR with tests + canary artifacts. will include reproducer, logs, and perf run plan. thanks all.
